judgeAll(uint256,bytes).details: llmInput should contain the FULL assembled prompt:              rubric + all revealed answers          The precompile (0x0802) executes synchronously and returns          the AI judge's ranking/review as aiReview bytes.

params.llmInput: Full LLM prompt bytes (rubric + assembled answers).

revealAnswer(uint256,string,bytes32).details: Contract recomputes keccak256(abi.encodePacked(answer, salt, msg.sender, bountyId))          and compares against the stored commitment.          Auto-advances from SUBMISSION → REVEAL on first valid reveal.

submitCommitment(uint256,bytes32).details: One commitment per participant per bounty.          Commitment MUST be: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(answer, salt, msg.sender, bountyId))

createBounty(string,string,uint256,uint2.notice: Create a bounty. msg.sender becomes the owner.          Reward ETH is locked in this contract.

finalizeWinner(uint256,uint256).notice: Finalize the winner and pay the reward.          Only callable by the bounty owner after judging.

getBountyCore(uint256).notice: Get core bounty metadata (smaller return to avoid stack too deep).

getBountyInfo(uint256).notice: Get bounty extra metadata (participant count, winner, aiReview).

getRevealedCount(uint256).notice: Count revealed submissions for a bounty.

judgeAll(uint256,bytes).notice: Judge all revealed answers using Ritual's on-chain LLM inference          precompile. One batch call — NOT per-submission.          Only callable by the bounty owner after the reveal deadline.

revealAnswer(uint256,string,bytes32).notice: Reveal the answer + salt during the reveal window.

submitCommitment(uint256,bytes32).notice: Submit a commitment hash during the submission window.
